narr: Storms moved southward across southern Missouri producing heavy rainfall and damaging winds. Flooding occurred on several low water areas.
ev: The Professional Building at Cherry Street and Kimbrough had water in the first floor.
A local hospital emergency room reported water from flash flooding due to very heavy rainfall. This caused the ER to closed, diverting ambulance traffic to other hospitals.
A water rescue was reported at the intersection of Grant Avenue and Commercial Street due to flooding.
The intersection of Cherry Street and National Avenue were reported as impassable due to high water.
The intersection of Jefferson and Chestnut Avenues were reported as flooded and impassable.
Flooding was reported at the intersection of Campbell and Chestnut Avenues.
A water rescue was reported at the intersection of Chestnut Expressway and National Avenue due to flooding.
A water rescue was reported at the intersection of Main and Mill Streets.
Wilsons Creek was reported out of its banks and flooding Farm Road 146 near Rutledge Wilson Farm. Additional heavy rainfall fell on the headwaters of the Jordan and Fassnight Creek basins.
